brief: Whether every array entry passes a test
description: Return true if predicate returns true for every entry of array (index order), or if array is empty. Entries whose value is undefined are included.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => boolean
parameters.description: Called for each entry of array until it returns false. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: predicate
